entities.name: Methyl ester hydrolysis
observations: The encoded transformation converts an aromatic methyl ester, Ar-C(=O)OCH3, into the corresponding carboxylic acid, Ar-C(=O)OH.
The reaction is consistent with base-promoted ester saponification rather than sulfur transfer or aryl substitution.

entities.name: LiOH THF water hydrolysis
observations: The matching empirical record uses LiOH and water in THF; ethyl acetate is also listed and is likely an extraction/workup solvent.
Acidification may be used during workup to isolate the free carboxylic acid, but it was not explicitly listed in the record.

entities.name: SELFIES P/S artifacts
observations: The apparent phosphorus and sulfur symbols in the token strings are encoding artifacts; standardized structures show no actual phosphorus or sulfur substitution in the substrates or products.
